label: SCG I.22 n.6 main causal premise, self-source horns and intrinsic unity rival
summary: For #1623, pinned and materialized all SCG I.22 nn.1–11 from the same SHA256-verified Corpus Thomisticum page snapshot already used by SCG I.18 (new passage 4eebc2d7, file aquinas-scg-i22-lat.json); read the complete primary context, plus existing materialized ST I q.3 a.7, De ente capp.1–2 and Aristotle Metaphysics H.6. The historical n.6 main premise concerns a cause of substantial esse BELONGING to a quiddity when it is not de essentia, not merely a source for a joining; its explanatory per-se-unity clause is distinct, and the cause dichotomy is intrinsic/extrinsic relative to the QUIDDITY, not relative to esse. Thus the old checked coFundamentalProfile, with distinct represented e/q and per-se unity but no joining source, violates the proposed full n.6 main premise if both substantial belonging and not-of-essence hold; it was never a countermodel to that premise. The old selfSourcedProfile with source s=e is external TO q if e is praeter q, not automatically n.6's self-causing-intrinsic-to-q horn; bridging a joining source to a cause of q's substantial being, and q's actual identity as the first bearer's quiddity, is required. Aristotle H.6 plus De ente cap.1 supply a substantive immanent potential/actual unity mechanism for distinct constituent roles without a third uniter; however their matter/form are both within composite essence, form actualizes matter asymmetrically, and generation admits a mover. They do not yet warrant an unsourced co-fundamental esse outside the quiddity of a necessary first. I.22 n.8 independently treats real distinct co-requisites as composition but needs the pre-established simplicity premise and a real-constituent bridge. A precise conditional skeleton, model extensions (not newly checked), rejected inferences and provisional warrant are in docs/notes/scg-i22-contingent-conjunction.md. No new claims, theorems, cases, actual-R bridges or root edges; no premise changes.
blocker: OPEN before a D→E result: (1) semantic criterion and warrant for not-of-essence and the inference to not per-se one, rather than merely represented inequality/no part; (2) whether joining source and caused substantial esse belonging are the SAME explanatory relatum, and whether intrinsic causal role is sufficient EFFICIENT self-production rather than the permissible FORMAL cause of a composite's esse (materialized De ente cap.1 [69872] and cap.3 [69874], whose latter wording restricts the self-production ban to efficient causation); (3) a typed bridge OutsideQuiddity(e,q) → ¬OfQuiddity(e,q) before classifying self-sourced s=e as external to q; (4) separate First(x) actual bearer and cause sorts: the joining source s has Principle type but the q.3 actual efficient cause and R-support source have Being type, requiring explicit source presence, correspondence and distinctness; (5) the external-to-quiddity cause-to-firstness argument, including the case s=e=x, and q must be the actual q3.essenceOf of the SAME first x; (6) a positive and noncircular necessary-first co-constitution. The checked old profiles do not settle these metaphysical premises. Next test: add independent substantial-belonging/outside-quiddity/source-location predicates to the existing dependence profile and test both causal kinds and horns, plus independent I.22 n.7 potency/act and n.8 composition pressure under the separately open pure-act/simplicity and real-constituent premises. No toolchain for Lean/Comparator/NanoDa in this run.
